Name: Coal Veins - Better Coal Nodes
Author: HoangTuDaa18
Description:
[b][size=4]Coal Veins - Better Coal Nodes[/size][/b]
Ever felt like coal is a little too inconvenient to find while exploring the Mines?
[b]Coal Veins[/b] brings the vanilla Coal Nodes to the regular Mines, giving players another way to gather coal without changing the original mining experience.
The mod reuses existing Coal Nodes from Stardew Valley, keeping their original appearance, drops, and interactions while introducing configurable spawn rates and adjusted durability.
[heading][quote][color=#ffff00]Features[/color][/quote][/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Coal Nodes in the Mines:[/b] Vanilla Coal Nodes can now appear throughout the regular Mines (Floors 1–119).[/*]
[*][b]Configurable Spawn Rate:[/b] Adjust the chance of finding Coal Nodes on each floor.[/*]
[*][b]Up to 3 Coal Nodes:[/b] A floor can rarely contain multiple Coal Nodes, with a weighted distribution to keep them balanced.[/*]
[*][b]Balanced Durability:[/b] Coal Nodes have adjusted durability based on your pickaxe upgrade level.[/*]
[/list][heading][quote][color=#9900ff]Spawn Settings[/color][/quote][/heading]
Default settings:
[list]
[*]Floor Spawn Chance: 15%[/*]
[*]1 Coal Node: 90%[/*]
[*]2 Coal Nodes: 9%[/*]
[*]3 Coal Nodes: 1%[/*]
[/list]This makes single-node appearances common, while finding two or three Coal Nodes on the same floor is increasingly rare.
[heading]Pickaxe Durability[/heading]
Coal Nodes created by this mod use the following durability:
[table][tr][th]Pickaxe[/th]
[th]Hits Required[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Basic Pickaxe[/td]
[td]3[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Copper Pickaxe[/td]
[td]2[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Steel Pickaxe[/td]
[td]2[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Gold Pickaxe[/td]
[td]1[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Iridium Pickaxe[/td]
[td]1[/td]
[/tr]
[/table][heading]Configuration[/heading]
Coal Veins supports [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b].
You can customize the floor spawn chance and node distribution directly in the game.
GMCM is optional. Without it, you can still edit the settings through the config.json file.
[heading][quote][color=#ff7700]Requirements[/color][/quote][/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (Optional)[/*]
[/list]Content Patcher is not required.
[heading][quote][color=#ff7700]Compatibility[/color][/quote][/heading]
Coal Veins reuses vanilla Coal Nodes and only adds them to eligible locations in the regular Mines. It does not replace the original Coal Nodes found in other locations.
